race.comment: ULTIMATE ATOM (1) resumes after finishing eighth at her latest appearance at Launceston on June 21. A nice draw on the front line should ensure a cosy run. Meets a comparable field so she will be hard to beat. VITESSE (4) finished sixth last start, beaten 11 metres at Launceston over 1680m. Expect her to be prominent. BLISSFULL RED (3) is in the mix following a fourth at her most recent appearance over 1680m at Launceston. HARLEY GLENWOOD (7) is worth some thought after his last-start fifth over 1680m at Launceston on November 15.
